fusions.name: Smelled the Weak One
fusions.desc: Only usable on a target at or below 30% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. Lunges for 24 damage, consuming every affliction on the target and adding 1.3 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Thrashing Frenzy
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Thrashes at every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 8 damage, making each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Circling Fury
fusions.desc: Circles your prey, working yourself up: your attack speed rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of the Wounded
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.
